explanation: Asks whether there is a betrothed pair (σ(m) = σ(n) = m + n + 1) of the same parity, with m ≠ n. The m ≠ n requirement is justified, since m = n would be a quasiperfect number. Wikipedia notes that all known pairs have opposite parity. The definition matches Wikipedia and OEIS A005276, and the statement is faithful.
